author: Inside Edition
description: A delivery man was detained in connection with the kidnapping of Nancy Guthrie but he says he is innocent and has never heard of the woman or her TV anchor daughter Savannah Guthrie. Carlos Palazuelos tells Inside Edition he was making a Door Dash food delivery with his wife when he saw police following him, so he pulled over. His home and his car were raided. Palazuelos says after eight hours, police told him he was clear, but his name and image have gone worldwide. He says he wants an apology.
title: Man Released After Questioning About Nancy Guthrie Speaks Out

author: Inside Edition
description: The FBI is continuing to harvest the 44-second video of a masked person at Nancy Guthrie's home for every possible clue. Experts believe the intruder height is 5'9" to 5'11" and weighs up to 230 pounds. Several firearms experts say he was armed with what appears to be a nine millimeter handgun. Forensic video analyst Conor McCourt spoke to Inside Edition's Alison Hall. Authorities are reportedly paying attention to the suspected kidnapper's gait.
title: FBI Analyzes Surveillance Video Of Masked Man At Nancy Guthrie's Door

author: Inside Edition
description: "Dawson's Creek" star James Van Der Beek has died after his two-year battle with colon cancer. His wife shared the news, writing, "He met his final days with courage, faith and grace." Van Der Beek shared six kids with his wife Kimberly. His last public appearance was in December. He opened up about his health on the "TODAY" show. The actor was diagnosed with stage three colorectal cancer in August 2023 after a routine colonoscopy. Van Der Beek was 48.
title: 'Dawson's Creek' Star James Van Der Beek Dies At 48

author: Inside Edition
description: Blake Lively and Justin Baldoni arrived in Federal Court in New York City for a court-ordered settlement conference, the first time they have come face-to-face since the start of their legal battle. The goal is for the actors to hash out their differences, put an end to their messy legal battle, and avoid going to trial. It has been over a year since Lively filed a lawsuit accuseing Baldoni of sexual harassment on the set of her 2024 film "It Ends With Us." Baldoni denies the allegations.
title: Blake Lively And Justin Baldoni Appear In Court

author: Inside Edition
description: The development in the Nancy Guthrie investigation within 24 hours came at rapid speed. Reporters delivered the news as it broke. Law enforcement released a surveillance photo and video of a "potential subject" in the Nancy Guthrie kidnapping. Police searched a home in the small town of Rio Rico, Arizona, and the homeowner revealed her son-in-law Carlos Palazuelos was being questioned by investigators. The man says he is innocent and was released by authorities.
title: Timeline Of Dramatic Developments In Nancy Guthrie's Kidnapping Case

author: Inside Edition
description: Many across the country are in a state of concern after video was released of an armed person at Nancy Guthrie's front door. Home improvement expert Jason Cameron shows Inside Edition how easy it can be to kick down a front door and how to help turn it into a fortress. Mary, 75, says she has been closely watching the Nancy Guthrie kidnapping story. She met with security expert Guy Cohen to see if her home in Los Angeles is vulnerable to a break-in.
title: Tips To Help Make Your Home More Secure

author: Inside Edition
description: Polar bears, singing toilets and a bevy of sitcom stars all made appearances in this year's commercials.
title: What Were The Best Ads Of Super Bowl Night? #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Protestors say they consider it theft that the pride flag was removed from the Stonewall National Monument in New York City. Those who showed up at the park to speak out say it's an attack on the LGBTQ community. The Monument was designated in 2016 as the site of a historic uprising in 1969 that sparked the modern LGBTQ rights movement. Last year, the letters T and Q were removed from the NPS webpage about the history of Stonewall. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Protestors Gather After Pride Flag Removed From Stonewall Monument

author: Inside Edition
description: Delia Rollek says a man burst into her home and duct-taped her, demanding money.
title: Elderly Kidnapping Victims Share Their Stories #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Singer Brooke Josephson announced she and her husband, Hollywood executive Barry Josephson, are getting divorced.
title: Singer Divorcing 'Bones' Producer Husband Named In Epstein Files #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: A barred owl is getting intense rehabilitation after it was found on a New York highway. Rick Leganhausen, a New York state trooper for Broome County, first spotted the injured animal and called All Creatures Great and Small Wildlife Rehabilitation. He stayed by the owl's side until they arrived. The small but feisty owl, named "Owlberto," is now getting fluids, pain meds, and much-needed rest. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: New York State Trooper Rescues Owl Possibly Hit By A Car

author: Inside Edition
description: Bad Bunny smashed the record for the most watched Super Bowl halftime show of all time with 135.4 million views. The show also gave his music a large booster. On the day after his halftime performance, Bad Bunny took the top six spots on Spotify's top 50 US chart. However, his performance sparked political backlash. Conservative commentators have been speaking out. One Republican congressman is calling for an investigation, claiming the show was "pure smut."
title: Bad Bunny Faces Backlash After Super Bowl Halftime Show
